desc.T1: OEE is availability times performance times quality, each at most 100%, so OEE cannot exceed 100%; 112% is impossible.
desc.T2: By Little's law, work-in-process equals throughput times lead time: at constant throughput, halving lead time halves WIP, and doubling WIP doubles lead time.
desc.T3: EOQ sets how much to order by balancing ordering and holding costs; it does not set safety stock, which depends on demand and lead-time variability and the target service level.
desc.T4: Excluding intermittent SKUs from the MAPE calculation changes what is measured; the forecasts did not become more accurate.
